links.outcome: Symptom extraction performance across patient demographic subgroups (fairness analysis)
links.effect: BioMedICUS generally showed stronger performance across patient demographics; both fine-tuned LLaMA models faced challenges in demographic fairness and generalizability.
links.quote: However, both LLaMA models faced challenges in demographic fairness and generalizability.

screen.reason: The study evaluates and compares fine-tuned LLMs with a traditional rule-based NLP tool for extracting symptom data from clinical text, including fairness evaluations across demographics, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or operational practice.
